newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Four Argentines die in Brazil bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Four Argentines die in Brazil bus crash.

text.p: Four Argentine holidaymakers were killed when their bus was involved in a crash with a lorry in southern Brazil on Wednesday, officials said.
A spokesman for the town of Tres Cachoeiras in Rio Grande do Sul state said that 22 people were injured.

An official at the hospital in Tres Cachoeiras said later that 12 had been released, eight remained interned with less serious injuries and two more seriously hurt had been taken to a hospital in the state capital, Porto Alegre.
The bus was travelling from the Argentine city of La Plata to the Brazilian beach resort of Camboria.
